import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        int rev;
        int cap;
        int cost;

        Edge(int dest, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] graph = new List[10001];
    static int[] visited = new int[10001];
    static int[] current = new int[10001];
    static int node_count;
    static int[] distance = new int[10001];
    static int[] potential = new int[10001];

    static int create_node() {
        return node_count++;
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[u].add(new Edge(v, graph[v].size(), cap, cost));
        graph[v].add(new Edge(u, graph[u].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    static boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(distance, INF);
        Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
        PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
        pq.offer(new int[]{distance[s] = 0, s});
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] top = pq.poll();
            int du = top[0], u = top[1];
            if (visited[u] != 0) continue;
            visited[u] = 1;
            for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                int v = e.dest;
                int dv = du + potential[u] + e.cost - potential[v];
                if (e.cap == 0 || visited[v] != 0 || distance[v] <= dv) continue;
                pq.offer(new int[]{distance[v] = dv, v});
            }
        }
        return visited[t] != 0;
    }

    static boolean bfs_layered(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        visited[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                int v = e.dest;
                if (visited[v] != 0 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                if (distance[v] != distance[u] + e.cost - potential[v] + potential[u]) continue;
                visited[v] = visited[u] + 1;
                q.offer(v);
            }
        }
        return visited[t] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int t, int f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        int pushed = 0;
        for (; current[u] < graph[u].size(); ++current[u]) {
            Edge e = graph[u].get(current[u]);
            int v = e.dest;
            if (e.cap == 0 || visited[v] != visited[u] + 1) continue;
            if (distance[v] != distance[u] + e.cost - potential[v] + potential[u]) continue;
            int df = dfs_flow(v, t, Math.min(e.cap, f));
            pushed += df;
            f -= df;
            e.cap -= df;
            graph[v].get(e.rev).cap += df;
            if (f == 0) break;
        }
        return pushed;
    }

    static int[] min_cost_flow(int s, int t, int max_flow) {
        int total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
        Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs_layered(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(current, 0);
                int df = dfs_flow(s, t, max_flow);
                max_flow -= df;
                flow += df;
                if (max_flow == 0) break;
            }
            total_flow += flow;
            total_cost += (distance[t] + potential[t]) * flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < node_count; ++i)
                potential[i] += distance[i];
            if (max_flow == 0) break;
        }
        return new int[]{total_flow, total_cost};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int layers = Math.max(n, k) * 2;
        node_count = 0;
        create_node();
        int source = create_node();
        int sink = create_node();
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            --a;
            add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 1; z <= m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            --u; --v;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n, v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n, v2 = v + i * n;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    add_edge(u1, v1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    add_edge(v2, u2, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int u = j + i * n, v = j + (i + 1) * n;
                add_edge(u, v, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < layers; ++i)
            add_edge(i * n, sink, INF, 0);
        System.out.println(min_cost_flow(source, sink, INF)[1]);
    }
}
